SELECT t1.FINPROD_ID tradeId, t1.FINPROD_ID intiTradeId, t4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID origRepSecId, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER as origRepSecNum, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE origPrintAmt, t2.PLEDGE_RATIO * 100 origConRatio, t6.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, t8.DEAL_CUR_ACCT acctNo, t1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, t1.TERM term, t1.PRIN tradeAmt, t1.INT_RATE*100 yield, to_char(t1.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') fristSettleDate, to_char(t1.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') expireSettleDate, t1.ACT_CAP_DAYS occupyDays, t1.M_INT_AMT intAmt, t1.M_TRADE_AMT expireSettleAmt, t1.COUNTER_ID counterId, t7.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, t8.TRADER trader, t8.COUNTER_SEAT seatId, t8.BUSI_PS repPs, t7.REMARK addCla, t3.type_7 ps, '01' as pledgeUnit, /** 质押券单位 **/ t8.COUNTER_CON_NO agreeOnId FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT t1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE t3 ON t3.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t3.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH AND t3.TYPE_6 = 'H01' AND t3.TYPE_7 IN('03','04') LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t2.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t4 ON t4.FINPROD_ID = t2.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t5 ON t5.FINPROD_ID = t1.FINPROD_ID AND t5.BRANCH = t1.BRANCH AND t5.PS in ('T01') INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD t6 ON t5.TRADE_ID = t6.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST t7 ON t7.ENTRUST_ID = t6.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD t8 ON t8.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID WHERE t5.f_trade_id = #{tradeId} AND t1.BRANCH = 0

SELECT t8.trade_id tradeId, t8.trade_id intiTradeId, t4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID origRepSecId, case when t7.trade_market = #{TRADE_PLACE_03} then t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10 else t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER end as origRepSecNum, t2.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE origPrintAmt, t2.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 origConRatio, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID newRepSecId, case when t7.trade_market = #{TRADE_PLACE_03} then t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10 else t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER end as newRepSecNum, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE newPrintAmt, t9.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 newConRatio, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID repSecId, case when t7.trade_market = #{TRADE_PLACE_03} then t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER/10 else t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER end as repSecNum, t9.PLEDGE_NUMBER* t2.PLEDGE_FACE_VALUE printAmt, t9.PLEDGE_RATIO*100 conRatio, t7.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, t8.DEAL_CUR_ACCT acctNo, t7.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, t8.TERM_DAYS term, t7.ENTRUST_AMT tradeAmt, t7.PRICE*100 yield, to_char(t8.VPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') fristSettleDate, to_char(t8.MPAY_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') expireSettleDate, t8.cap_days occupyDays, t8.M_INT_AMT intAmt, t8.M_TRADE_AMT expireSettleAmt, t7.COUNTER_ID counterId, t7.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, t8.TRADER trader, t8.COUNTER_SEAT seatId, t8.BUSI_PS repPs, t7.REMARK addCla, t7.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, t7.PS ps, t8.request_id reqOnId, case when t7.trade_market = #{TRADE_PLACE_03} then #{UNIT_04} else #{UNIT_01} end as pledgeUnit, /** 质押券单位 **/ t8.COUNTER_CON_NO agreeOnId FROM ETR_ENTRUST t7 INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD t8 ON t8.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_PLEDGE t9 ON t9.ENTRUST_ID = t7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t10 ON t10.FINPROD_ID = t9.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE t2 ON t2.FINPROD_ID = t8.trade_id AND t2.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT t4 ON t4.FINPROD_ID = t2.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID WHERE t7.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
